text: Flags the three useMemo filters as prompt-shaped — the general/notification/advanced split is hardcoded by key prefix convention rather than driven by a schema or config
Flags the generic SettingItem interface with a union type and type discriminator as premature generalization — it creates a mini type system instead of modeling concrete settings
Flags that both fetch calls ignore HTTP errors and have no .catch handler — a non-200 response silently produces bad state
Flags that handleSave does not handle failure — if the PUT fails, the user sees Save re-enabled with no error indication
